verdict.rationale: LangGraph's multi-agent docs describe patterns for coordinating specialized components. Its custom-workflow pattern lets you embed other multi-agent patterns as nodes in one LangGraph workflow alongside deterministic steps, and streaming exposes a subgraphs projection, which suggests nested graphs are supported. Missing for 10: the handoff and subagent patterns are not named or detailed in the evidence, and there is no hands-on or independent corroboration of multi-agent orchestration specifically.

support.subject: As a developer, I can orchestrate multiple agents — handoffs, subagents, or crews — inside one workflow

citations.quote: Here are the main patterns for building multi-agent systems, each suited to different use cases
Multi-agent systems coordinate specialized components to tackle complex workflows.
Build bespoke execution flows with LangGraph, mixing deterministic logic and agentic behavior. Embed other patterns as nodes in your workflow.
Event streaming gives you separate iterators per projection (messages, values, subgraphs, output)
